chunks: And whatever is in it from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Muṭahhar, the companion of Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام, I have narrated it from my father and Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with them both—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdullāh and ʿAbdullāh ibn Jaʿfar al-Ḥimyarī, all from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Muṭahhar, the companion of Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father, one of the author’s transmission authorities
key_terms.جَمِيعًا: all together, indicating that the named transmitters relate from the same source
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I narrated it, indicating direct transmission by the author
key_terms.صَاحِبِ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَ: the companion of Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام, identifying the narrator's association

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Muṭahhar in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad by which the author transmits reports from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Muṭahhar, a companion of Abū Muḥammad عليه السلام. Its significance lies in documenting the route of transmission in hadith literature and preserving the reliability and attribution of the reports.
